executed_by: AI assistant; learner independent implementation remains pending
protocol: Four fresh interpreters: continuous StepLR, interrupted StepLR, resume, fixed LR. Same seed, split, initialization, batches, epochs, update and sample budgets; only gamma differs (0.5 vs 1). No hyperparameter tuning on holdouts. Negative controls use early diagnostic cut min(split_epoch,7), then step_size+1 epochs, separate from the requested recovery cut/budget; this avoids assuming parameter effects remain observable after very late LR underflow. Bitwise recovery is limited to this CPU/software environment.

negative_controls.caveat: StepLR reset can preserve the LR trajectory at a step_size-aligned cut if current optimizer LR is retained; counters still differ.
